strings.zh: 我孙女的熊宝宝{NEWLINE}对食物的品质一直很挑呢,{CLEAR}到船上后它就不吃东西了,{CLEAR}可把我孙女给愁怀了。
strings.en: My granddaughter’s Teddiursa has{NEWLINE}always been picky about its food.{SCROLL}Since we came aboard, it won’t eat a{NEWLINE}thing, and my granddaughter is worried{CLEAR}sick.

strings.zh: 呜呜……我的熊宝宝{NEWLINE}怎么也不吃船上提供的食物,{CLEAR}真担心它会饿坏身体。{SCROLL}如果能有天然蜂蜜的话{NEWLINE}我想熊宝宝一定会爱吃的。{SCROLL}可以麻烦大哥哥{NEWLINE}帮我去厨房问问有没有蜂蜜吗？{CLEAR}拜托了！
strings.en: Sniff... My Teddiursa won’t eat any of{NEWLINE}the food on this ship. I’m so worried{CLEAR}it’ll get sick.{SCROLL}I’m sure Teddiursa would eat some{NEWLINE}natural honey, if we had any.{SCROLL}Big brother, could you please go ask{NEWLINE}the kitchen if they have any honey?{CLEAR}Please!

strings.zh: 呜呜……我的熊宝宝{NEWLINE}怎么也不吃船上提供的食物,{CLEAR}真担心它会饿坏身体。{SCROLL}如果能有天然蜂蜜的话{NEWLINE}我想熊宝宝一定会爱吃的。{SCROLL}可以麻烦大姐姐{NEWLINE}帮我去厨房问问有没有蜂蜜吗？{CLEAR}拜托了！
strings.en: Sniff... My Teddiursa won’t eat any of{NEWLINE}the food on this ship. I’m so worried{CLEAR}it’ll get sick.{SCROLL}I’m sure Teddiursa would eat some{NEWLINE}natural honey, if we had any.{SCROLL}Big sister, could you please go ask the{NEWLINE}kitchen if they have any honey? Please!

strings.zh: 熊宝宝『Teddi……
strings.en: Teddiursa: Teddi...

strings.zh: 我这次进了不少好货,{NEWLINE}等会儿派对时拿出来卖{CLEAR}一定大赚一笔！
strings.en: I stocked up on lots of good stuff this{NEWLINE}time. I’ll sell it at the party later and{CLEAR}make a killing!

strings.zh: 哦？问我有没有高档的浅水盐？{SCROLL}有是有啦,不过那个也是{NEWLINE}要在派对上出售的商品。{CLEAR}你如果现在就想买的话{CLEAR}可是要付四倍的价钱哟。
strings.en: Oh? You’re asking if I have any{NEWLINE}high-grade Shoal Salt?{SCROLL}I do, but it’s stock for the party too.{NEWLINE}If you want it now, you’ll have to pay{CLEAR}four times the price.

strings.zh: 那么,6000元一份浅水盐,{NEWLINE}你要买吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: So, $6000 for one Shoal Salt. Will you{NEWLINE}buy it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你好穷啊,{NEWLINE}连6000元都拿不出来……
strings.en: You’re so poor! You can’t even come up{NEWLINE}with $6000...
strings.notes: | RV052: softened: 你好穷啊 is a flat jab, not a question

strings.zh: 我的浅水盐绝对是上好的调味品,{NEWLINE}您尽管放心使用！
strings.en: My Shoal Salt is top-notch seasoning.{NEWLINE}Use it with confidence!

strings.zh: 男人不要靠近我,{NEWLINE}我喜欢的是年轻貌美的姑娘！
strings.en: Men, stay away from me! I only like{NEWLINE}young, pretty girls!

strings.zh: 啊！美丽的姑娘,{NEWLINE}跟你在这豪华游轮上相遇{CLEAR}仿佛就是命中注定！{CLEAR}不知姑娘今晚愿与我同席而眠否？
strings.en: Ah! Lovely maiden, meeting you aboard{NEWLINE}this luxury liner must be destiny!{SCROLL}Would you do me the honor of sharing my{NEWLINE}bed tonight?
strings.notes: Faithful: zh 同席而眠 (sleep together), mock-classical pickup line.

strings.zh: 要送出身上的蜂蜜吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Give away the Honey?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哇！大哥哥要送给我蜂蜜吗？{NEWLINE}真的太谢谢你了！
strings.en: Wow! You’re giving me honey, big{NEWLINE}brother? Thank you so much!

strings.zh: 哇！大姐姐要送给我蜂蜜吗？{NEWLINE}真的太谢谢你了！
strings.en: Wow! You’re giving me honey, big sister?{NEWLINE}Thank you so much!

strings.zh: 来,熊宝宝,{NEWLINE}这是你最爱吃的蜂蜜喔！
strings.en: Here, Teddiursa! It’s honey, your{NEWLINE}favorite!

strings.zh: 熊宝宝『Teee——ddi！
strings.en: Teddiursa: Teee-ddi!

strings.zh: 这次真的多亏了大哥哥,{NEWLINE}不然熊宝宝可能要饿一路肚子了。
strings.en: Thank you so much, big brother.{NEWLINE}Otherwise Teddiursa might have gone{CLEAR}hungry the whole trip.

strings.zh: 这次真的多亏了大姐姐,{NEWLINE}不然熊宝宝可能要饿一路肚子了。
strings.en: Thank you so much, big sister.{NEWLINE}Otherwise Teddiursa might have gone{CLEAR}hungry the whole trip.

strings.zh: 广播『各位旅客,{NEWLINE}本游轮的豪华派对即将开始。{CLEAR}欢迎大家到大厅来参加派对。
strings.en: Announcement: Attention, passengers.{NEWLINE}Our grand party is about to begin.{SCROLL}Please join us in the main hall.

strings.zh: 哇！好像很好玩的样子。{NEWLINE}大哥哥咱们快去参加派对吧！
strings.en: Wow! That sounds fun! Big brother,{NEWLINE}let’s hurry to the party!

strings.zh: 哇！好像很好玩的样子。{NEWLINE}大姐姐咱们快去参加派对吧！
strings.en: Wow! That sounds fun! Big sister, let’s{NEWLINE}hurry to the party!

strings.zh: 多亏了你,{NEWLINE}我孙女又笑逐颜开了。{CLEAR}这是我的小小心意请你收下。
strings.en: Thanks to you, my granddaughter is all{NEWLINE}smiles again.{SCROLL}Please accept this small token of my{NEWLINE}thanks.

strings.zh: 走吧,一起去参加派对吧。
strings.en: Let’s go to the party together.

strings.zh: 奶奶虽然年纪大了,{NEWLINE}但是还可以这样到处旅行。{CLEAR}身子骨真是硬朗啊。
strings.en: Grandma may be getting on in years, but{NEWLINE}she can still travel around like this.{CLEAR}She’s really tough.

strings.zh: 喔呵呵,{NEWLINE}跟心爱的孙女一起出来旅行,{CLEAR}真的很开心呢。
strings.en: Oh ho ho, traveling with my darling{NEWLINE}granddaughter is such a joy.

strings.zh: 什么？派对开始了？{SCROLL}没关系不用管我,{NEWLINE}我这个岁数的人了,{CLEAR}还是比较喜欢清净的旅行。
strings.en: What? The party’s started?{SCROLL}Never mind me. At my age, I prefer a{NEWLINE}quiet trip.

strings.zh: 这次去城都的阿鲁夫遗迹{NEWLINE}多拍几张照片的话,{CLEAR}我考古学家的人设就立得更稳了。
strings.en: If I take a few more photos at the{NEWLINE}Ruins of Alph in Johto this time...{SCROLL}...my archaeologist act will be even{NEWLINE}more convincing.

strings.zh: 哟呵,小妹妹快看我的吐火绝技！
strings.en: Yo-ho! Little miss, check out my{NEWLINE}fire-breathing trick!

strings.zh: 哇好棒好棒,叔叔你好厉害！
strings.en: Wow, so cool! Mister, you’re amazing!

strings.zh: 大哥哥快看,{NEWLINE}这个叔叔会使用喷射火焰呢！
strings.en: Big brother, look! This mister can use{NEWLINE}Flamethrower!

strings.zh: 大姐姐快看,{NEWLINE}这个叔叔会使用喷射火焰呢！
strings.en: Big sister, look! This mister can use{NEWLINE}Flamethrower!

strings.zh: 多亏这个喷火艺人,{NEWLINE}我孙女才没有察觉现在的危险。
strings.en: Thanks to this fire-breather, my{NEWLINE}granddaughter hasn’t noticed the{CLEAR}danger we’re in.

strings.zh: 奶奶您尽管放心,不会有事的。
strings.en: Don’t worry, Grandma. Everything will{NEWLINE}be fine.

strings.zh: 好,好。{NEWLINE}奶奶相信你可以保护大家的。
strings.en: Yes, yes. Grandma believes you can{NEWLINE}protect everyone.

strings.zh: 我这个朋友的实力也很强的,{NEWLINE}要是不晕船的话一定能帮上大忙。
strings.en: My friend here is really strong too. If{NEWLINE}he weren’t seasick, he’d be a big help.

strings.zh: 呕……比起火箭队来,{NEWLINE}还是晕船更难对付吧。
strings.en: Urp... Seasickness is way harder to{NEWLINE}deal with than Team Rocket.

strings.zh: 如果一会儿游轮沉没的话,{NEWLINE}你一定要勇敢地跟我一起跳海,{CLEAR}I jump,you jump！
strings.en: If this ship sinks, you have to be brave{NEWLINE}and jump into the sea with me. I jump,{CLEAR}you jump!
strings.notes: zh quotes the Titanic line in English ("I jump, you jump").

strings.zh: 我宁可加入火箭队{NEWLINE}也不会跟你跳海的。
strings.en: I’d sooner join Team Rocket than jump{NEWLINE}into the sea with you.

strings.zh: 要是乖乖把钱和精灵交给火箭队,{NEWLINE}是不是可以保全性命啊？
strings.en: If we just hand our money and Pokémon{NEWLINE}over to Team Rocket, maybe they’ll let{CLEAR}us live?

strings.zh: 如果这次能活着回去的话,{NEWLINE}我再也不假扮考古学家当托了。
strings.en: If I make it back alive, I’ll never pose{NEWLINE}as an archaeologist to shill for anyone{CLEAR}again.

strings.zh: 我……我身上没有值钱的东西,{NEWLINE}什么都没有！
strings.en: I... I don’t have anything valuable on{NEWLINE}me! Nothing at all!

strings.zh: 怎么办……{NEWLINE}我好像把火箭队的人给坑了,{CLEAR}他们不会来报复我吧？
strings.en: What do I do... I think I scammed a Team{NEWLINE}Rocket member. They won’t come after{CLEAR}me, will they?

strings.zh: 喂,大叔,{NEWLINE}你的那个产黄金的鲤鱼王呢？{CLEAR}还有吗？我要买啊！
strings.en: Hey, mister, where’s that gold-making{NEWLINE}Magikarp of yours? Got any more? I want{CLEAR}one!

strings.zh: 别、别胡说！{NEWLINE}我什么时候卖过鲤鱼王了！
strings.en: D-don’t talk nonsense! When did I ever{NEWLINE}sell a Magikarp?!

strings.zh: 明明就有啊,在刚刚的派对上……
strings.en: You totally did, at the party just{NEWLINE}now...

strings.zh: 你认错人了,快去找别人吧。
strings.en: You’ve got the wrong guy. Go bother{NEWLINE}someone else.

strings.zh: 居然敢明目张胆地劫持圣安努号,{NEWLINE}火箭队这是在向精灵联盟挑衅吗？
strings.en: Hijacking the S.S. Anne right out in the{NEWLINE}open? Is Team Rocket trying to pick a{CLEAR}fight with the Pokémon League?

strings.zh: 嗯？什么？{NEWLINE}非常想念你的巴大蝴？{CLEAR}那么,你想用拉达{CLEAR}再换回你的巴大蝴吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hm? What’s that? You really miss your{NEWLINE}Butterfree?{SCROLL}Then do you want to trade my Raticate{NEWLINE}back for your Butterfree?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 嗯,我会照顾好你的巴大蝴的,{NEWLINE}请放心吧。
strings.en: Okay. I’ll take good care of your{NEWLINE}Butterfree, don’t worry.

strings.zh: 你这只不是拉达嘛。
strings.en: That’s not a Raticate.

strings.zh: 这样就交换完毕了,{NEWLINE}你的巴大蝴又再属于你了。
strings.en: The trade’s done. Your Butterfree is{NEWLINE}yours again.

strings.zh: 火箭队要是敢闯进来,{NEWLINE}洒家就手撕了这帮贼搓鸟！
strings.en: If Team Rocket dares barge in here,{NEWLINE}this old boy will tear those thieving{CLEAR}bastards apart with his bare hands!
strings.notes: tone review: 贼搓鸟 (Water Margin 撮鸟) is a crude Water Margin curse (鸟 oath); kept crude as 'thieving bastards' (D-0627); supersedes provisional D-0460

strings.zh: 本来只是想出来旅行写个生,{NEWLINE}结果遇到火箭队这种恐怖分子。{SCROLL}我觉得可以根据这番遭遇创作一幅画,{NEWLINE}名字的话……{CLEAR}就叫做「海jiong」吧！
strings.en: I only wanted to travel and do some{NEWLINE}sketching, and I ran into terrorists{CLEAR}like Team Rocket.{SCROLL}I think I’ll paint a picture based on{NEWLINE}what happened. As for the title...{SCROLL}I’ll call it ‘Lost at Sea’!

strings.zh: 我练了这么长时间的对战技巧,{NEWLINE}结果真有事情发生时,{CLEAR}却连出手帮忙都做不到。{SCROLL}唉,我以前还是把事情想的太简单了。
strings.en: I trained my battle skills for so long,{NEWLINE}but when something really happened, I{CLEAR}couldn’t lift a finger to help.{SCROLL}Sigh... I used to think things were so{NEWLINE}simple.

strings.zh: 小蓝『等我确认这里安全了之后{NEWLINE}就去帮你。{CLEAR}在外面跟火箭队周旋的事就先靠你啦。
strings.en: Green: Once I make sure it’s safe here,{NEWLINE}I’ll come help you.{SCROLL}Until then, dealing with Team Rocket out{NEWLINE}there is up to you.

strings.zh: 小赤『等我确认这里安全了之后{NEWLINE}就去帮你。{CLEAR}在外面跟火箭队周旋的事就先靠你了。
strings.en: Red: Once I make sure it’s safe here,{NEWLINE}I’ll come help you.{SCROLL}Until then, dealing with Team Rocket out{NEWLINE}there is up to you.

strings.zh: 妙蛙种子『Bul——ba！
strings.en: Bulbasaur: Bul-ba!

strings.zh: 谢谢大哥哥给的蜂蜜,{NEWLINE}我的熊宝宝可爱吃了！
strings.en: Thank you for the honey, big brother!{NEWLINE}My Teddiursa loves it!

strings.zh: 谢谢大姐姐给的蜂蜜,{NEWLINE}我的熊宝宝可爱吃了！
strings.en: Thank you for the honey, big sister! My{NEWLINE}Teddiursa loves it!

strings.zh: 多亏了你,{NEWLINE}我孙女又笑逐颜开了。{CLEAR}这是我的小小心意请你收下。
strings.en: Thanks to you, my granddaughter is all{NEWLINE}smiles again.{SCROLL}Please accept this small token of my{NEWLINE}thanks.

strings.zh: 一会儿派对上见咯。
strings.en: See you at the party.

strings.zh: 新圣安努号上的伙食不错嘛,{NEWLINE}出门旅行就该是美景美食相伴才对。
strings.en: The food on the new S.S. Anne is pretty{NEWLINE}good. A trip should come with great{CLEAR}views and great food.

strings.zh: 我的精灵是皮丘,不是皮卡丘哦！
strings.en: My Pokémon is a Pichu, not a Pikachu!

strings.zh: 皮丘『Piii——chu！
strings.en: Pichu: Piii-chu!

strings.zh: 为了研究各地的精灵生态,{NEWLINE}我不得不坐船到处跑。{CLEAR}虽然辛苦倒也乐趣良多。
strings.en: To study Pokémon ecology around the{NEWLINE}world, I have to travel everywhere by{CLEAR}ship.{SCROLL}It’s hard work, but it’s a lot of fun{NEWLINE}too.
